blocks.text: Beta-elimination woh reaction hai jis mein beta carbon (halogen wale carbon ke saath wala carbon) ka hydrogen atom aur halogen atom hat'te hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab base beta hydrogen par hamla kare; halogen saath ya baad mein nikalta hai, aur substitution product ki bajaye alkene banti hai. Elimination substitution ke saath saath hota aur aksar us se muqabla karta hai. Substitution ki tarah yeh bhi do mechanisms, E2 ya E1, par chal sakta hai.

items: E2 (bimolecular): base beta hydrogen par hamla karta aur leaving group usi waqt nikalta jab C=C double bond banta hai, aik qadam mein. Raftaar halogenoalkane aur base dono par munhasir: rate = k[halogenoalkane][base], second order.

E1 (unimolecular): SN1 ki tarah pehla qadam substrate ki sust ionisation se carbocation; doosre qadam mein base beta hydrogen hata kar alkene deta. Raftaar sirf halogenoalkane par munhasir: rate = k[halogenoalkane].

blocks.alt: Oopar, E2: base B- bromoethane ke CH3 carbon ke hydrogen par hamla karta, C-H ke electrons C-C bond mein aur C-Br ke electrons Br par, sab aik saath, CH2=CH2 + H-B + Br- bante. Neeche, E1: (CH3)3C-Br sust ionise ho kar (CH3)3C+ + Br-; phir base methyl group se hydrogen hatata, 2-methylpropene (CH3)2C=CH2 banti.
blocks.caption: E2 aur E1 mechanisms (kitab ke khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: E2 mein sab kuch aik saath aik qadam mein hota hai: base beta hydrogen leta, naya pi bond banta aur bromide nikalta. E1 mein pehle carbocation banta hai, bilkul SN1 ki tarah, aur phir base parosi carbon se proton le kar double bond banata hai.

blocks.text: Primary halogenoalkanes aam taur par E2 aur tertiary halogenoalkanes E1 par chalte hain, jab ke secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ke mutabiq koi bhi dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane, (CH3)3C-CH2Br, elimination karta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: beta carbon, C(CH3)3, par koi hydrogen nahi, is liye base ke hatane ko koi beta hydrogen nahi.

items: Beta-elimination beta-H aur X hata kar alkene deta.
E2: aik qadam, rate = k[RX][base]; E1: carbocation ke zariye, rate = k[RX].
Primary: E2; tertiary: E1; secondary: dono.
